brand.name: Gotty

appDownloadPrompt.title: Gotty feels better in the app
appDownloadPrompt.description: Take your library everywhere and discover your next games through a smoother, more immersive experience made for your phone.

adBlockPrompt.description: Gotty is a small, free project built for the community. Ads are our only way to cover its costs and keep making it better for everyone.

landing.heroSubtitle: Discover what's coming, save what you want to play, and track your progress across every platform.

features.title: Everything your backlog needs
features.subtitle: From discovery to the credits, Gotty keeps your gaming life organized in one place.

discover.title: A feed that knows what's next
discover.description: Curated rows of trending, upcoming and acclaimed titles across every console — always fresh, always yours.

library.description: Save the games you own, add the ones you're watching to your wishlist, and keep everything in one tidy place.

progress.title: Track every playthrough
progress.description: Log your status and playtime per game — from “not started” all the way to the credits rolling.

how.title: Start in three moves
how.subtitle: No setup, no spreadsheets. Your library is ready in under a minute.
